clips.title: City and inn
steps: Stand at a nice street spot, UI showing: `/cine demo hook` (UI fades, letterbox in), then `/cine demo hook-back`
Hover the action bars, then the minimap (hover reveal, its group comes up)
`/cine demo chat-peek`, then `/cine demo speech` (chat pops up, speech from behind)
Walk through the crowd past chatty NPCs (nameplates by kind, text-only bubbles)
Target a player and hover them (styled target frame, tooltip)
Cast a self-buff or a weapon enchant (buff peek)
Talk to a quest giver, read, accept (Quest Cam, Quest Vision)
Walk mode + auto-run down the main street (RP Walk Cam)
Walk into the inn (Rested card, inn glow)
`/cine demo cozy-tour`, then sit in a chair, then stand and draw your weapon (Cozy Cam)
clips.do: A busy capital, ending in its inn. CineMode off at the start. About 6–8 min.

clips.title: Travel: flight, mount, Hearthstone
steps: `/cine demo flight-director`, then take the flight (Flight Cam, fly-bys)
Land (settling camera, Flight arrival card, zone card)
Mount up and auto-run down a road (Auto-run Cam; skyriding on retail)
Stop, Hearthstone (Tele Cam, Tele Vision)
clips.do: A flight master, on a route you've flown before. About 3–5 min.

clips.title: Questing and combat
steps: Tracking on, ride toward the quest area past a node (minimap stays up)
Look over the quest mobs and objects (quest marks)
Pull one mob (combat frames, combat cards and sound, Cooldown Manager on retail, then it all fades)
Pull several and let your health drop (Vitals Vision)
Die (Death Cam, its song, Death card)
clips.do: A low-level zone with an unfinished kill/collect quest. About 4–6 min.

zoomGuide.wide: Full frame (only cut to the video's shape). Cameras, tints, cards, the world. Normal UI Scale.
zoomGuide.medium: Crop to about half the frame, on the area named. Normal UI Scale is fine.
zoomGuide.close: The window fills most of the frame. Record with UI Scale turned on at max (1.15) so the text is sharp, then crop to it.
